from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from aos7_mailopen import summarize

class TestMail(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            self.assertEqual(summarize(Path(tmp)), {'v': 1, 'open': []})

    def test_letters(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            samples = {'bob/inbox/done/q.md': '---\nfrom: alice\nto: bob\nstatus: REQUEST\nid: q\nre: \n---\n# 請求', 'alice/inbox/r.md': '---\nfrom: bob\nto: alice\nstatus: DONE\nid: r\nre: q\n---\n# 回覆'}
            for rel, text in samples.items():
                p = root / rel
                p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                p.write_text(text)
            for rel in ('bob/inbox/.tmp/fake.md', 'alice/inbox/.draft.md', 'teams/dev/inbox/broadcast.md'):
                p = root / rel
                p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                p.write_text(samples['bob/inbox/done/q.md'])
            self.assertEqual(summarize(root), {'v': 1, 'open': []})
